content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

- **§ 2.1 (p0013)** carries both preferred elements verbatim: "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall."
- **§ 12.3 (p0051)** independently confirms Customer "has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."
- **§ 7.1 (p0026)** prevents Vendor from imposing a "minimum-use, or similar charge" not identified in the Order Form.
- Sections 4 (Order Forms) and 8 (Term and Renewal) contain no committed spend, non-reducible quantities, volume caps on Customer usage, or shortfall/take-or-pay mechanic; renewal only rolls the stated term forward with a capped uplift.

Nothing to narrow or exit from, so the fallback true-up/reduction machinery is unnecessary. (Separately noted, not under this rule: § 7.7's late-payment liquidated damages at fifteen percent of annual Fees per week is a payment-penalty issue for the liquidated damages rule, not a minimum commitment.)
